speaker: Ms Mariam Jaafar
text: asked the Minister for Transport considering the continued rise in motorcycle COEs whether additional measures to the changes implemented in March 2022 to encourage prudent bidding are being considered.

speaker: Ms Mariam Jaafar (Sembawang)
text: We agree that the Government has done quite a bit in trying to contain the issue of motorcycle COEs, including the move on prudent bidding.

speaker: Ms Mariam Jaafar (Sembawang)
text: It did have an impact for a few months after the implementation.

speaker: Ms Mariam Jaafar (Sembawang)
text: But motorcycle COEs are now going up again.

speaker: Ms Mariam Jaafar (Sembawang)
text: This is a really important issue to the people who actually rely on their motorcycles to do their work.

speaker: Ms Mariam Jaafar (Sembawang)
text: Can the Ministry say more if it is willing to consider raising the bid further?

speaker: Ms Mariam Jaafar (Sembawang)
text: Or if that is not the issue, are there any other moves that can help to bring down motorcycle COEs?

speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
text: I think many other Members of Parliament, including the Government Parliamentary Committee Chairman Mr Saktiandi Supaat has also raised these concerns.

speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
text: As I have said, we understand the concerns of the potential buyers of, for instance, motorcycles, particularly if it is for their livelihood.

speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
text: As I have also noted in my earlier reply, we have made some moves in March with regard to the validity period – we shortened it and raised the bid deposit.

speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
text: Just a question for the Senior Minister of State, in view of the reply to the hon Member Ms Mariam Jaafar.

speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
text: In the last decade, I understand LTA had allowed for the transfer of up to 25% of COEs originally put aside for Cat D motorcycles and allowed them to be transferred to the Open Category.

speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
text: That number then was reduced to 10% and I think now, the transfer is not allowed anymore – or at least, that policy has ceased, that is, the move from motorcycle COEs to the Open Category, to Cat E.

speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
text: I stand to be corrected but I do not think that there has been instances where we have actually done the reverse.
